intended_object: A helper function giving the diagonal entries, as units, of the diagonal matrix diag(1, …, u, …, 1), which has u in the pivot position and 1 everywhere else. It is used to conjugate matrices in the proof about determinants and conjugation in GL_n. This is inferred from the docstring and from how the definition is used at lines 127–141 of the same file.
explanation: The body is `if index = pivot then unit else 1`. This is exactly `Pi.mulSingle pivot unit` in the group Rˣ. It is an internal building block: the library feeds it into `Matrix.diagonal` and uses it to compute entries of the conjugated matrix in the conjugation lemma. It is not a mathematical notion of its own. It does compute what the docstring says: the diagonal entries, valued in units, with `unit` in the pivot position and 1 elsewhere. It also adds no hypotheses beyond the ones already in scope (a commutative ring R and a type n with decidable equality). So it is correct, but it is a proof device rather than a mathematical object.
